leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the digestive tract and urinary organs into named slots was clear but predictable; there was not much to figure out once the parts were ready.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though some placements followed named slots and goals rather than requiring much independent reasoning.

continue.text: I would probably continue if another chapter explored how the assembled systems interact. This finale tied the parts together, though the straightforward placements were less engaging.
